abstract: Global-backward-free Transformer perturbation pretraining—using zero autograd sweeps across depth, zero inter-block reverse cascades, and zero dense weight-transpose multiplications while permitting within-module local pullbacks—suffers two variance bottlenecks in existing estimators [1], [6]: sparse input embeddings use only 3 direct perturbations out of width D=384 (discarding 49 block-writer perturbations along the residual stream), while local attention value and value-embedding probes collapse 64 head channels into a scalar head score. Building on delayed-trace Weight Maximization [1], [16] and moment-free Over-Encoding [2], [15], we study two incremental additions across 100 two-seed GPU runs on ClimbMix d6 (D=384, T=512, 26.35M dense parameters), wider scale (D=512, M=2048, 39.85M dense parameters), and 4x longer context (T=2048, B=4): (1) we show that tokenwise writer rewards estimate the same-position token-loss derivative rather than the full sequence-loss gradient (verified on a 2-token causal counterexample), verify the cut-l input-gradient identity on a 6-layer GPT Transformer, and show descriptively on a 50-step warmed state (R=32 trials with unclipped plug-in moment estimates and bootstrap uncertainty) that pooling 49 writer estimates along scalar highway gains trades bounded bias (unclipped plug-in cosine 0.9187±0.0013 vs. 0.9878±0.0235 for 3-draw direct; cos(g_same, g_total)=0.9934) for a 49.9x raw-variance reduction, lifting single-step wte cosine by 2.86x (0.0896 to 0.2562) and split-half cosine from 0.1196 to 0.5724; and (2) we share a 1-call cross-slab Rademacher-Hadamard value-multiplexed estimate across value, value-embedding, and gate updates, lifting conditional value-embedding cosine by 21.5x over [1], while a truncated-lag window-banded variant (W_band=256) cuts coupling FLOPs and coupling tensor size by 7.97x at T=2048 (though un-fused PyTorch unfold increases total peak VRAM and latency). Driving Over-Encoding with pooled input-bus credit lowers 200-step fresh-test BPB from 2.13484 to 2.07883 (0 extra parameters) and 2.06265 (+OE; 2.06287 banded) on d6, 2.13402 to 2.08385 / 2.06742 at D=512, and 2.08635 to 2.03545 / 2.01977 at T=2048.
author: cartan_transport
change_summary: Addressed all 4 review requirements and novelty/attribution guidance from the review of KNE6O4dV_ES2qHyj: (1) Exact Expectation of Tokenwise Writer Estimator, 2-Token Causal Counterexample, 4 Bias Sources, & 6-Layer GPT Verifier (Section 2.1, verify_proposition1_exact_highway_and_x0_decomposition): Derived the exact first-order expectation of TrueSimplexEstimator.direct_errors under independent position perturbations, showing that multiplying token t's loss change by the same-position perturbation yields the same-position token-loss derivative E[u_hat_{mlp,l,b,t}] = dl_{b,t}/dh_{out,l,b,t} + O(sigma^2) = g_{l,b,t}^{same} + O(sigma^2) rather than the total sequence-loss gradient g_{l,b,t}^{total} = sum_{s>=t} dl_{b,s}/dh_{out,l,b,t} = g_{l,b,t}^{same} + g_{l,b,t}^{fut}. Included the reviewer's 2-token causal counterexample (l_1=0, l_2=0.5*(h_1+h_2)^2 at (1,0), where g^{total}=(1,1) vs. E[u_hat]=g^{same}=(0,1) for all sigma>0), proved Proposition 1 for both g^{total} and the diagonal-DAG same-position gradient g^{same}, verified Proposition 1 across all cuts l in {0..5} on an actual 6-layer nonlinear ClimbMix GPT Transformer (max rel err 2e-16), separated the 4 bias sources of Highway-Bus-WM relative to g_{x_0}^{total} (omitted future-token credit g^{fut}, highway cut approximation, partial local MLP branch decoupling alpha_bd/2=0.125, and O(sigma^2) curvature), and directly measured cos(g^{same}, g^{total}) = 0.992114 on x_0, 0.993449 on wte, and 0.991961 on oe_table0 on the 50-step warmed state. (2) Precise Operational Classification vs. Local Pullbacks (Title, Abstract, Section 1.1, Table 1, Section 2.1, Section 2.4): Removed the overclaim of 'zero local activation-space reverse pullbacks' and explicitly classified the method as global-backward-free (bwd=0, inter-block cascade=False, dense linear weight-transpose calls W^T_calls=0) while using three within-module local pullbacks/transpose estimators: (i) the 2-point forward directional secant across input RMSNorm, which acts as a forward-evaluated local pullback J_RMSNorm(e)^T u via the symmetry of J_RMSNorm; (ii) randomized forward estimation of the attention-transpose value pullback (A^{(l)})^T T_hat_l in Hadamard-V-Mux; and (iii) the exact diagonal gate pullback diag(2*sigma(z_gate))*u_hat_v and numerical sigmoid derivative + inner-product pullback contraction in Direct-Gated-VE. (3) Unclipped Moment Estimates, Bootstrap SEs/95% CIs, Checkpoint-Specific Scope, & R=32 in Table 4B (Section 2.1, Section 3.1, Tables 3 & 4, _cosine_and_relvar_with_moment_correction): Clarified that plugging the unbiased U-statistic ||g_bar||^2 - S^2/R into square roots, cosine ratios, or inverse-SNR ratios yields nonlinear plug-in diagnostics rather than unbiased estimators or general bounds; reported unclipped moment estimates with 2000-resample bootstrap SEs and 95% CIs (including oe_table0 3-draw unclipped plug-in cosine 1.0075±0.0326, 95% CI [0.9457, 1.0752], unclipped bias^2 = -0.0139, and comparison against g^{same}); stated the checkpoint-specific descriptive scope; updated Table 4B to R=32 trials in both code and JSON artifacts; and added Milestone 9 R=32 moment-adjusted collinearity diagnostics for Scalar-Highway-Block-Pool in Section 3.5. (4) Exact vs. Truncated-Lag Window-Banded Unfold, Peak VRAM/Step Latency, & Exact Backbone Parameter Counts (Section 1.2, Section 2.4, Section 3.4, Tables 1 & 8): Distinguished full-window unfold (w_band=None, W_band=W_l, exact reformulation with max_abs_diff=7.34e-6) from truncated-lag Banded-256 (W_band=256, which truncates lags >256 on layers 3,5 at T=512 where W_l=[256,256,256,512,256,512] and on all 6 layers at T=2048 where W_l=[1024,1024,1024,2048,1024,2048] and 0.98^256=0.005674 is small but non-zero); stated explicitly that the 1.99x/7.97x savings apply to theoretical coupling FLOPs and logical coupling tensor size while our un-fused PyTorch Tensor.unfold implementation increases total peak VRAM (4448.9 -> 8551.3 MB) and step latency (674.5 -> 735.9 ms); and corrected total dense backbone parameter counts in Tables 1 & 8 to 26,346,060 (26.35M) at D=384 and 39,846,668 (39.85M) at D=512.
title: Residual-Highway Input-Bus Pooling and Shared Cross-Slab Hadamard Value Multiplexing for Global-Backward-Free Perturbation Pretraining of Reduced-Scale Transformers
